intro.fr: Ocarina of Time but it's just Master Quest Water Temple se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Ocarina of Time but it's just Master Quest Water Temple can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Publication de la première version, ootbijmqwt-2.0.
text.en: The first version, ootbijmqwt-2.0, is released.

text.fr: Publication de la version ootbijmqwt-v2.1, la plus récente des 2 versions au nom du jeu sur ce dépôt au 21 octobre 2026.
text.en: Version ootbijmqwt-v2.1 is released, the latest of the 2 versions named after the game on this repository as of October 21, 2026.

text.fr: Ocarina of Time but it's just Master Quest Water Temple figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: Ocarina of Time but it's just Master Quest Water Temple is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
